name: player pass touchdown percentage renders 0 rather than blank on a zero numerator (executed-result parity)
description: Seed four 2024 dropbacks for one passer, none of them a touchdown. The rate is 0/4, which is 0.00 percent -- a defined value, not an unknown one. Until the measure conversion this column guarded on CASE WHEN SUM(<numerator>) > 0, so a passer with attempts and no touchdowns rendered BLANK; four of its siblings (interception percentage, interception-worthy percentage, and the two successful-play percentages) carried the same numerator guard. One combine means the only thing that can make a rate undefined is a zero DENOMINATOR. Red at 5a5180851, where the column returns null.
